items.q: Boiling point is the temperature at which:
options: the vapour pressure of a liquid equals the external pressure
optionsAf: die dampdruk van ’n vloeistof gelyk is aan die eksterne druk
items.explain: This is the definition used in marking guidelines.
items.explainAf: Dit is die definisie wat in nasienriglyne gebruik word.

items.q: Which compound has the lowest vapour pressure at 25 °C?
items.qAf: Watter verbinding het die laagste dampdruk by 25 °C?
items.explain: Propanoic acid has the strongest intermolecular forces (hydrogen bonds at two sites), so it evaporates least.
items.explainAf: Propanoësuur het die sterkste intermolekulêre kragte (waterstofbindings op twee plekke), dus verdamp dit die minste.

items.q: The strongest intermolecular forces between propanone molecules are:
items.qAf: Die sterkste intermolekulêre kragte tussen propanoonmolekule is:
items.explain: The polar C=O group gives dipole–dipole forces; there is no O–H for hydrogen bonding.
items.explainAf: Die polêre C=O-groep gee dipool–dipoolkragte; daar is geen O–H vir waterstofbinding nie.

items.q: Which compound has the highest boiling point?
items.qAf: Watter verbinding het die hoogste kookpunt?
items.explain: Pentane is unbranched with the largest contact area, so its London forces are strongest.
items.explainAf: Pentaan is onvertak met die grootste kontakoppervlakte, dus is sy Londonkragte die sterkste.

items.q: In an investigation comparing alcohols with different chain lengths, the independent variable is:
items.qAf: In ’n ondersoek wat alkohole met verskillende kettinglengtes vergelyk, is die onafhanklike veranderlike:
items.explain: The investigator changes the chain length and measures the boiling point.
items.explainAf: Die ondersoeker verander die kettinglengte en meet die kookpunt.

items.q: Why are compounds of similar molar mass chosen when comparing functional groups?
items.qAf: Waarom word verbindings met soortgelyke molêre massa gekies wanneer funksionele groepe vergelyk word?
options: So that their London forces are about the same
So that they have the same boiling point
So that they react in the same way
optionsAf: Sodat hul Londonkragte ongeveer dieselfde is
Sodat hulle op dieselfde manier reageer
items.explain: Similar size keeps London forces equal, so only the functional group differs (a fair test).
items.explainAf: Soortgelyke grootte hou Londonkragte gelyk, dus verskil net die funksionele groep (’n regverdige toets).

items.q: The intermolecular force that gives alcohols and carboxylic acids high boiling points.
items.qAf: Die intermolekulêre krag wat alkohole en karboksielsure hoë kookpunte gee.

items.q: The temperature at which a solid changes to a liquid.
items.qAf: Die temperatuur waarby ’n vastestof in ’n vloeistof verander.

items.q: Carboxylic acids form … between two molecules (two hydrogen bonds), which is why their boiling points are so high.
items.qAf: Karboksielsure vorm … tussen twee molekules (twee waterstofbindings), en daarom is hul kookpunte so hoog.

items.text: As the chain length of alkanes increases, the strength of London forces [[]], so the boiling point [[]].
items.textAf: Soos die kettinglengte van alkane toeneem, [[]] die sterkte van Londonkragte, dus [[]] die kookpunt.

items.q: More branching in an alkane lowers its boiling point.
items.qAf: Meer vertakking in ’n alkaan verlaag sy kookpunt.
items.explain: True. Branched molecules have a smaller contact surface, so intermolecular forces are weaker.
items.explainAf: Waar. Vertakte molekules het ’n kleiner kontakoppervlak, dus is intermolekulêre kragte swakker.

items.q: Propane has a higher vapour pressure than propan-1-ol.
items.qAf: Propaan het ’n hoër dampdruk as propan-1-ol.
items.explain: True. Propane has only weak London forces, so it evaporates much more easily.
items.explainAf: Waar. Propaan het net swak Londonkragte, dus verdamp dit baie makliker.

items.q: Ketones form hydrogen bonds between their own molecules.
items.qAf: Ketone vorm waterstofbindings tussen hul eie molekules.
items.explain: False. Ketones have no H bonded to O; they have dipole–dipole forces.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Ketone het geen H gebind aan O nie; hulle het dipool-dipool-kragte.

items.q: Put these compounds of similar molar mass in order of increasing boiling point.
items.qAf: Rangskik hierdie verbindings met soortgelyke molêre massa in volgorde van toenemende kookpunt.

items.q: Explain why ethanol has a higher boiling point than methoxymethane (dimethyl ether), which has the same molar mass.
items.qAf: Verduidelik waarom etanol ’n hoër kookpunt het as metoksiemetaan (dimetieleter), wat dieselfde molêre massa het.
points: Ethanol has an –OH group and forms hydrogen bonds between its molecules.
Methoxymethane has only weaker dipole–dipole/London forces, so less energy is needed to separate its molecules.
pointsAf: Etanol het ’n –OH-groep en vorm waterstofbindings tussen sy molekules.
Metoksiemetaan het net swakker dipool-dipool-/Londonkragte, dus is minder energie nodig om sy molekules te skei.
